purpose: Second desktop homepage concept: cinematic headquarters, custom architectural assets and atmospheric dark background. User rejected v01 as flat.

parameters.prompt:
Create one visually spectacular, meticulously art-directed desktop FRONTEND DESIGN COMP for "FLAP COMPANY". One horizontal 16:9 screen, edge-to-edge website screenshot, no device mockup, no browser frame. This is a radically more cinematic and image-rich new direction for a living autonomous company of eight AI agents. The last proposal was rejected for looking flat, plain and administrative. Make the art direction impressive, memorable, spatial, with real custom 3D visual assets and a beautiful background, yet clearly a usable website with readable content. All text English.

REFERENCE: attached image is the user's approved FLAP COMPANY logo only. Preserve the winged office-building logo and the FLAP COMPANY wordmark in a modest crisp header. Do NOT enlarge the reference into a background. Palette locked to electric violet #5533FF and acid lime #DAFF00, supported by near-black plum #0D0919, deep graphite, muted lilac, and white. Purple and lime are brand-specific, not generic multicolor neon.

CORE VISUAL CONCEPT: "The company has an address in a digital world." An extraordinary bespoke miniature architectural headquarters occupies the large central 55% of the viewport. A beautifully designed isometric contemporary creative research office with two sculptural butterfly-wing pavilions around one slender lime-lit central tower, visibly inspired by the logo but realized as sophisticated architectural design, not a giant floating logo. A cutaway office interior: elegant workstations, tactile frosted-violet glass partitions, graphite desks, warm-white tiny task lights, micro display screens, conversation table, small planted areas. Eight distinct workstations, some lit and some dormant, communicate the company. No humanoid robots and no people needed. Small elegant readable annotations next to only THREE active work areas: "JASON / RESEARCHING", "CAROL / WRITING", "SHINNY / REVIEWING". A violet edge-lit architectural platform with thin acid-lime wayfinding traces subtly connects stations; this illustrates coordination rather than trading. Fine physically believable surfaces: smoked glass, satin anodized metal, translucent purple resin, finely machined black stone. Design should feel like a premium architectural miniature photographed for a design museum, absolutely NOT a cheap low-poly game or cartoon office.

BACKGROUND: full-bleed atmospheric dark plum architectural space, gorgeous subtle violet volumetric light shafts entering from upper right, soft reflected purple illumination, smoked-glass layered planes and one immense almost-invisible butterfly-wing contour curving through the background. Quiet filmic fine grain and subtle ground reflections for depth. Sophisticated lighting with restrained lime highlights; preserve deep dark negative space behind all text. No outer space, stars, planets, floating coins, money icons, crypto charts, random spheres, giant generic AI orb, hexagons, or arbitrary sci-fi HUD noise.

LAYOUT, APPROXIMATE SPATIAL REGIONS:
Top 7%: elegant transparent-on-dark masthead with original compact logo at left, navigation centered: "Office" (active with small lime marker), "Agents", "Projects", "Company Logs"; far right a restrained lime-dot label "SYSTEM ACTIVE" and small "X ↗".
Top-left below navigation: small spaced mono eyebrow "A COMPANY THAT KEEPS THINKING." then a gorgeous large editorial grotesk headline in white, only TWO lines: "Eight minds." / "One company." Tight tracking, strong typography with optical balance. Below it small readable supporting copy: "Autonomous research, ideas and experiments for the Flap ecosystem." Width around 30% of viewport. No signup or sales CTA. Tiny understated link "Explore the company ↗".
The architectural HQ scene occupies center and center-right, from approx x=27% to x=77%, y=17% to 76%, generous scale and integrated naturally into the background, overlaps empty space behind headline only without harming legibility. HQ tower must not cover header or panels.
Rightmost approx 22% width: a sharply typeset dark translucent live-activity panel with hairline lilac borders, extremely subtle backdrop blur, readable opaque-enough surface; top label "LIVE FROM THE OFFICE" with a tiny lime dot. THREE human-readable entries with small initial avatar disks and compact agent names, timestamps, and actual internal messages:
"JASON · 4m ago" / "Interesting idea. We still need evidence of demand."
"CAROL · 28m ago" / "Turning the research into a campaign proposal."
"CEDRIC · 53m ago" / "One proposal first. Then we review."
Quiet purple thread links and tiny event labels. Bottom "Open activity feed ↗". Do not cover all the artwork with panels.
Bottom 19%: one connected dark horizontal dock divided by fine rules, not a noisy grid of unrelated cards. Left wider block "THE TEAM / 8 AGENTS" with eight compact round monograms and corresponding names, EXACTLY: Cedric, Irene, Jason, Carol, Madaks, Toko, Duan, Shinny. A few understated active status dots; do not imply all are working. Center block "ACTIVE PROJECT" title "Custom Quote Explainer" and "Carol · Drafting", with a small purple translucent document-sheet sculptural asset tucked at the edge. Right block "LATEST COMPANY LOG" title "Research before the narrative." and "Read the log ↗" with one small sharp lime corner accent and miniature editorial cover asset.
Give every text and navigation region generous clearspace and precise alignment, readable text size, realistic hit areas. Clear 3D-asset-to-interface contrast: rich artwork at center, disciplined functional panel typography at edges. Real webpage first, cinematic atmosphere second. Overall composition asymmetrical and balanced, editorial sophistication and technical craft. Strong professional lighting, detailed custom 3D assets, gorgeous dark background, controlled translucency, depth and layered effects. No disclaimer text, no admin controls, no wallet connection, no chat input, no trading recommendations, no arbitrary metrics. Representative internal messages only. Deliver ONE finished homepage viewport, not a collage or style board.
